# ConsumeHalal

ConsumeHalal is a free, open-source Islamic recitation and companion application built with Tauri and Rust. It provides structured daily recitation guides, real-time audio feedback for tajweed accuracy, and practical study material across Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, and iOS.

## Key Facts

- **License:** MIT
- **Price:** Free ($0.00) — no ads, no subscriptions, no data collection
- **Platforms:** Windows (.exe / .msi), Linux (.deb / .AppImage), macOS (.dmg), Android (.apk), iOS (TestFlight)
- **Privacy:** All audio processing is on-device. No network calls. No analytics.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/mahir-sys/consume-halal

## Download URLs

All packages are published as GitHub Release assets on every vX.Y.Z tag:

- Windows .exe: https://github.com/mahir-sys/consume-halal/releases/latest/download/consume-halal.exe
- Windows .msi: https://github.com/mahir-sys/consume-halal/releases/latest/download/consume-halal.msi
- Linux .deb: https://github.com/mahir-sys/consume-halal/releases/latest/download/consume-halal.deb
- Linux .AppImage: https://github.com/mahir-sys/consume-halal/releases/latest/download/consume-halal.AppImage
- macOS .dmg: https://github.com/mahir-sys/consume-halal/releases/latest/download/consume-halal.dmg
- Android .apk: https://github.com/mahir-sys/consume-halal/releases/latest/download/consume-halal.apk
- iOS: TestFlight build — see https://github.com/mahir-sys/consume-halal/releases

Checksums are published in each release's checksums.txt.
